question: A ________ is a retail establishment that combines a department store and a grocery supermarket.
solution:
The correct answer is __**hypermarket**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

A **hypermarket** is a retail establishment that combines a department store and a grocery supermarket.

 
• **Hypermarket Definition:** A hypermarket is a large retail store that offers a wide variety of products, including groceries, clothing, electronics, home goods, and other general merchandise, all under one roof.
 
• **Combination of Store Types:** It essentially merges the characteristics of a department store, which sells a broad range of non-food items, and a supermarket, which specializes in food and grocery products.
 
• **Large Size:** Hypermarkets are typically very large, often occupying significant floor space. This allows them to stock a vast selection of goods.
 
• **One-Stop Shopping:** The concept behind a hypermarket is to provide customers with a convenient one-stop shopping experience, where they can purchase almost everything they need in a single location.
 
• **Wide Variety:** Hypermarkets offer a greater assortment of products compared to regular supermarkets or department stores. This includes a wide selection of brands and product categories.
 
• **Competitive Pricing:** Due to their large size and high sales volumes, hypermarkets often offer competitive prices on their products.
 
• **Ample Parking:** Hypermarkets usually have large parking lots to accommodate the large number of customers they attract.
 
• **Other Services:** In addition to selling merchandise, some hypermarkets may also offer services such as pharmacies, restaurants, optical shops, or photo processing.
 
• **International Presence:** Hypermarkets are a common retail format in many countries around the world.
